description.value: Three small Rainbow Trout–stocked lakes linked by 6.5 km of easy trails in mature Kootenay forest, with warm-water swimming at the 3rd lake and paddling on two of the three lakes; accessed via Highway 3B off Highway 3, with a seasonal opening around mid-May.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Champion Lakes is an operating provincial park campground (opening May 14, 2026 for the season, which has passed as of today). The phone number on the contact page (1.250.825.4212) matches OSM. The site is described as 'rustic' with no internet (OSM: internet_access=no). The trip planner page explicitly mentions cyclists touring local roads. Food nearby is confirmed via the website mentioning Fruitvale as a 'full service community' close to the park with a grocery store, and Salmo 20 minutes away with groceries and restaurants.
concerns: Described as rustic with no internet access (confirmed by OSM tag); no specific hiker/biker site information found, so cycle tourists may need a full-size site
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate provincial park campground with 95 sites in a scenic area explicitly noted for touring cyclists; offers a rustic camping experience relevant to bike tourists on Kootenay routes.
